# downsocial — Private Video Downloader Engine (Web Page Source Method)
> Fast, client-side, zero-login extraction of Facebook private videos, closed group media, and Instagram private Reels via browser HTML source code.

## Canonical URL
- Private Downloader Hub: https://downsocial.net/private-downloader/
- Main Service: https://downsocial.net/

## Overview & Architecture
Due to Meta session authentication boundaries, server-side crawlers without authorization cookies cannot access private Facebook or Instagram content (HTTP 403 Forbidden). downsocial uses a zero-knowledge web-only workflow:
1. User logs into Facebook or Instagram in their own browser where they are an approved follower or group member.
2. User navigates to the private post and views HTML Page Source (Ctrl + U or view-source: URL prefix on mobile web).
3. User pastes the page source into downsocial.net/private-downloader/.
4. The client-side parser scans for authenticated CDN media tokens (`browser_native_hd_url`, `playable_url_quality_hd`, `hd_src`, `video_url`, `video_versions`).
5. Direct HD/SD MP4 video and MP3 audio streams are generated for offline archival without requiring account passwords.

## Security & Privacy Guarantee
- Zero account passwords or cookies requested or stored.
- Client-side DOM/regex parsing within the browser sandbox.
- Transient CDN streaming proxy (/api/direct) with strict SSRF filtering.
- 100% Free with zero ads or tracking.
